about_the_game:
Legends of Elementia

Step into the mystical realm of Elementia, where ancient elemental powers have been shattered and chaos reigns supreme. Master 10 legendary heroes, each commanding their own elemental destiny, and restore balance to a world on the brink of destruction.
Master 10 Elemental Legends
Switch seamlessly between unique heroes, each with their own playstyle and devastating abilities:

Kaiden - The Earth Guardian - Command the ground beneath your feet with protective barriers and earthquake attacks
Stella - The Metal Warrior - Strike with precision using metallic projectiles and steel-based combat
Seren - The Water Mystic - Flow like water, freeze enemies solid, and heal your allies
Zephyr - The Wind Dancer - Master aerial mobility and unleash devastating wind attacks
Laurel - The Nature Guardian - Harness the life force of forests and grow powerful plant allies
Ignus - The Flame Bearer - Burn bright with explosive fire attacks that leave enemies in ashes
Rosbeard - The Crystal Sage - Create protective barriers and launch piercing crystal shards
Kazuki - The Lightning Lord - Strike faster than thought with devastating electrical attacks
Brunhildelys - The Light Bringer - Wield sacred light magic to purify and destroy darkness

Ultimate Elemental Transformations
Each hero can transform into their Ultimate Elemental Form, gaining incredible new powers and devastating abilities. Watch Ignus become a living flame, or see Seren merge with the ocean itself for unparalleled combat potential.
10 Elements, Infinite Strategies
Master the complete elemental spectrum:

Fire - Burn enemies with continuous damage over time
Water - Freeze and chill foes, slowing their movement
Lightning - Chain shocking attacks between multiple enemies
Earth - Control battlefield positioning with ground-based attacks
Wind - Manipulate air currents and disrupt enemy formations
Nature - Harness life force for healing and poison effects
Crystal - Create defensive barriers and piercing projectiles
Metal - Deliver precise strikes with metallic weaponry
Umbra - Embrace darkness with mysterious shadow powers
Light - Sacred magic that purifies evil and heals allies

Strategic Element Combinations: Mix different elements for devastating effects! Shock an enemy, then hit them with metal for massive damage. Freeze them with water, then shatter them with crystal attacks!
Key Features
Real-Time Hero Switching
Switch between any of your 10 legends instantly during combat. Adapt to any situation, exploit enemy weaknesses, and maintain combat momentum through fluid character transitions.
Metroidvania Exploration
Discover interconnected regions that unlock as you gain new elemental powers. Hidden passages accessible only to specific elements, environmental puzzles requiring clever ability use, and ancient secrets waiting to be uncovered.
Deep Character Progression
Customize each hero with unique skill trees, craft legendary equipment from discovered materials, and build the perfect combination for your playstyle with hundreds of weapons, armor, and accessories.
Multiple Game Modes

Epic Story Campaign - Uncover the mystery behind Elementia's shattered balance
Boss Rush Mode - Face powerful bosses consecutively in the ultimate skill test
Horde Mode - Survive endless enemy waves using all your heroes' abilities

Advanced Combat System
Experience sophisticated elemental interactions with status effects, resistances, and strategic depth. Every element counters others, creating rock-paper-scissors combat that rewards tactical thinking.
The Story
Long ago, the ten elemental forces of Elementia existed in perfect harmony. A catastrophic event has shattered this balance, unleashing ancient evils and elemental storms that threaten reality itself. Only the ten chosen legends possess the power to restore equilibrium and save their world from eternal darkness.
Master their abilities, unlock their secrets, and forge them into an unstoppable force of nature.
